lobby.title: Online room
lobby.text: Send the link to the other players. The game starts when all four seats are taken.

full.title: This room is full
full.text: Too many people are connected to this room right now.

busy.title: Can’t create a room yet
busy.text: Too many rooms were created from this network. Wait a minute, then try again.

gone.title: This room is gone
gone.text: The game is no longer on the server: the room sat empty, or the server restarted.

unreachable.title: Can’t reach the game server
unreachable.text: No room could be created because the game server didn’t answer. Start it with npm run server.

rateLimited.alert: Too many clicks at once: some were ignored. Try again.
